mathematical_scope: Finite connected simple triangle- and four-cycle-free base graph H and complete-graph width m>=4, open common-neighbor complex only.
scientific_integrity: Prior cycle-base homotopy case is credited, and the published closed-neighborhood Čech theorem is distinguished explicitly. All-parameter proof is symbolic with finite computational corroboration; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Nonequivariant integral homotopy type; the graph must be finite connected and have neither 3- nor 4-cycles, with clique width at least 4; prior-work search and finite verification are bounded and do not establish publication priority or an independent proof check.
title: Open-neighborhood topology of clique fibers over graphs without short cycles
